statBlock.name: Dust Mephit
statBlock.description: A winged elemental of air and fine earth that haunts forgotten places and treats death as a joke.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. It takes 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage on a hit.
Blinding Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature is Blinded until the end of the mephit's next turn.
Sleep (1/day). Cast Sleep using Charisma (save DC 10), without spell components.

statBlock.name: Ice Mephit
statBlock.description: A winged elemental of frost and cold air. It freezes whatever it can and slips ice into travelers' clothes.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 10 Constitution save. It takes 5 (2d4) Cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage on a hit.
Frost Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 10 Constitution save. It takes 7 (3d4) Cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
Fog Cloud (1/day). Cast Fog Cloud using Charisma, without spell components.

statBlock.name: Magma Mephit
statBlock.description: A winged creature of molten rock that enjoys melting things and attacks magmins on sight.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. It takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage on a hit.
Fire Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. It takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

statBlock.name: Mud Mephit
statBlock.description: A winged elemental of earth and water that smears mud over belongings and ruins unattended food.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, that creature is Restrained until the end of its own next turn.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage on a hit.
Mud Breath (recharge 6). Choose one creature the mephit can see within 15 ft. That creature makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Restrained until the end of the mephit's next turn.

statBlock.name: Smoke Mephit
statBlock.description: A winged figure of cinders and hot air that takes pleasure in misleading people and mocking them afterward.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, that creature is Poisoned until the end of its own next turn.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage on a hit.
Cinder Breath (recharge 6). Choose one creature the mephit can see within 15 ft. That creature makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Blinded until the end of the mephit's next turn.

statBlock.name: Steam Mephit
statBlock.description: A winged creature of heated vapor that promises rewards for favors and rarely pays up.

sections.Traits:
Blurred Form. Attack rolls against the mephit have Disadvantage unless it is Incapacitated.
Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. It takes 5 (2d4) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage on a hit.
Steam Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 5 (2d4) Fire damage and loses 10 ft. of Speed until the end of the mephit's next turn. A success halves the damage and leaves Speed unchanged. Being underwater grants no Resistance to this Fire damage.

statBlock.name: Magmin
statBlock.description: A little creature of flame and volcanic rock that treats anything flammable as kindling.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the magmin dies, each creature in its 10-ft. Emanation makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. It takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions: Touch. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage on a hit. A creature or an unworn, uncarried flammable object hit this way starts Burning.
sections.Bonus actions: Ignited Illumination. Kindle or extinguish its own flames. While ablaze, it sheds Bright Light in a 10-ft. radius and Dim Light for another 10 ft.
sections.Burning hazard: A burning creature or object takes 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to drop Prone and roll to extinguish its own flames. Dousing, submerging, or smothering the fire also puts it out.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 200. Burning follows Player's Handbook (2024), p. 362.
